## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 28, 2026 - Aug 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JackHans2837_, Aug 1, 2026, 1/5: "I kept giving the mobile app “one more chance,” but nothing changed. Every update, same story: endless loading, constant lag, and days where it barely works. I already spent enough time dealing with support and got nowhere. I’m done troubleshooting a product I’m paying for."
            2. _Shadowcobain33_, Jun 28, 2026, 1/5: "The recent update has completely broken the utility of the "Earnings" feature on the charts. Removing the "More Financials" button which provided critical, clear projection charts and interactive data and replacing it with an automated AI text summary provides zero value for technical analysis. This platform is continuously degrading the user experience with disruptive updates. The recent modifications to the drawing tools menu already severely hindered efficiency, and removing the financial charts is the final straw. Traders pay for TradingView for precise, visual data and speed, not to read automated text paragraphs or deal with a constantly shifting interface. If the original interactive earnings pop-up and functionality are not restored, I will be canceling my Premium subscription immediately. Stop prioritizing unwanted AI features over functional trading tools."
